mapper.sql: select schedule_id, offering_id, classroom_id, week_day, start_period, end_period, start_week, end_week, schedule_type, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from tpm_schedule
mapper.insert:
insert into tpm_schedule
offering_id, classroom_id, week_day, start_period, end_period, start_week, end_week, schedule_type, status, create_by, create_time, remark,
#{offeringId}, #{classroomId}, #{weekDay}, #{startPeriod}, #{endPeriod}, #{startWeek}, #{endWeek}, #{scheduleType}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark},
mapper.update: update tpm_schedule set del_flag = '2' where schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
update tpm_schedule set del_flag = '2' where schedule_id in #{scheduleId}
mapper.select: select s.schedule_id, s.offering_id, s.classroom_id, s.week_day, s.start_period, s.end_period, s.start_week, s.end_week, s.schedule_type, s.status, s.del_flag, cl.course_name as course_name, t.teacher_name as teacher_name, cr.classroom_name as classroom_name, b.building_name as building_name, o.max_students as max_students , o.teacher_id as teacher_id from tpm_schedule s inner join tpm_course_offering o on s.offering_id = o.offering_id left join tpm_course_library cl on o.course_id = cl.course_id left join brm_teacher t on o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id left join brm_classroom cr on s.classroom_id = cr.classroom_id left join brm_building b on cr.building_id = b.building_id where s.del_flag = '0' and o.del_flag = '0' and o.semester_id = #{semesterId} order by s.week_day, s.start_period

select s.schedule_id, s.offering_id, s.classroom_id, s.week_day, s.start_period, s.end_period, s.start_week, s.end_week, s.schedule_type, s.status, s.del_flag, cl.course_name as course_name, t.teacher_name as teacher_name, o.teacher_id as teacher_id from tpm_schedule s inner join tpm_course_offering o on s.offering_id = o.offering_id left join tpm_course_library cl on o.course_id = cl.course_id left join brm_teacher t on o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id where s.del_flag = '0' and o.del_flag = '0' and o.teacher_id = #{teacherId} and s.week_day = #{weekDay} and not (s.end_period < #{startPeriod} or s.start_period > #{endPeriod})

select s.schedule_id, s.offering_id, s.classroom_id, s.week_day, s.start_period, s.end_period, s.start_week, s.end_week, s.schedule_type, s.status, s.del_flag, cl.course_name as course_name, o.max_students as max_students , o.teacher_id as teacher_id from tpm_schedule s inner join tpm_course_offering o on s.offering_id = o.offering_id left join tpm_course_library cl on o.course_id = cl.course_id where s.del_flag = '0' and o.del_flag = '0' and o.semester_id = #{semesterId} and (s.classroom_id is null) order by o.max_students desc
